name: Unity games
author: Cell
summary: Runs Unity 2019+ games in borderless fullscreen at the Mac's native resolution, which avoids Unity's exclusive-fullscreen resolution switching bugs, and uses its Direct3D 11 renderer under DXMT.
useWhen: A Unity game opens in the wrong resolution, flickers when switching, or crashes with its Direct3D 12 renderer.

notes: Borderless fullscreen keeps the Mac's display mode, so switching resolution in the game no longer breaks the picture.

diagnostics.title: Unity could not start its renderer
diagnostics.advice: Cell will try the next graphics engine. You can also pick D3DMetal manually on the game's page.
